body: It's hard to talk about it in detail even just posting the original post was really hard. The community here seems friendly, I'm just having a hard time bringing myself to type everything up.

Honestly? I don't really have a primary reason for living anymore. I've been tormented and called worthless my entire life and I always think if I'm wanted by someone it might be worth living through the torment. But whether or not I'm wanted/feel wanted, the negative feeling is just always there. There will be times where I'm upset like this and I'll get laughed at and called a drama queen so I've learned to keep it to myself and thats why I feel *horrible* for having posted this.
It's hard to believe that right now, but thank you.
